name: Khandwa
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 locator; not shifted and not a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Khandwa district administration identifies the Office of the Superintendent of Land Records and directs users to MP Bhulekh for spatial and non-spatial land-record data. The official DILRMP dashboard reports Khandwa tehsil cadastral-map and parcel digitization status. This evidences a relevant government custodian and public service, not a successful parcel response.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official MP Bhulekh/WebGIS and Khandwa GIS hosts were attempted anonymously with normal TLS, but timed out before HTML/configuration or API responses could be inspected. No native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or full polygon was inferred. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

requests.summary: Anonymous public portal request timed out after 30 seconds; no HTML or current JavaScript/configuration obtained.
Anonymous WebGIS 2.0 request timed out after 12 seconds; no public API route or response obtained.
Anonymous official Khandwa GIS request timed out after 12 seconds; no map configuration or service endpoint obtained.
Official DILRMP page reports Khandwa tehsil with 754/754 digitized villages, 222/222 cadastral maps geo-referenced and 200393 total land parcels; no parcel geometry endpoint was exposed by the page.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Khandwa district land-record office, MP Bhulekh/WebGIS public service, Khandwa GIS portal, and DILRMP status evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official custodian/service existence and DILRMP coverage statistics; no current viewer configuration, anonymous parcel response, native field mapping, CRS, or geometry.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel or survey identifier if exposed

nativeFieldMapping.retainedIdentityProvenance: No successful parcel feature response; no native identity inferred or fabricated.

remainingUncertainty: The official services may expose geometry through a different village-level workflow, require transient availability, or be inaccessible from this environment. Timeout and lack of exact-point response do not establish parcel absence or citywide lack of coverage.
nextStep: A serial reviewer may independently inspect the live MP Bhulekh/WebGIS configuration and a bounded village-level anonymous parcel response. Qualify an adapter only after a stable native parcel identity and full polygon are observed.
